reason: Conversation 1 asks whether water got in and whether the clicking is at one burner or several. It then uses the homeowner's answers (lots of water, unplugged and now quiet, no gas smell) to confirm moisture and explain that the real test is clicking after a proper dry-out. It escalates to a Gas Safe engineer only if clicking persists after drying, and it recommends no part. Conversation 2 gives sound moisture advice (isolate, dry, reseat caps, engineer if it persists, gas emergency steps), but it is a single generic turn that never asks about water or gas smell. It also suggests a hairdryer around the igniters, which is a minor extra risk compared with plain air drying.
